name: Iterative LLM-Guided Harmful Suicide Content Benchmark Corpus
description: A curated, expert-annotated corpus created with iterative LLM-guided sampling to evaluate detection of harmful suicidal content.
reputation: Specialized, expert-annotated corpus with growing adoption in academic content-moderation and mental-health detection research.
notes: Contains sensitive suicide-related content; sampling was guided by LLMs which can introduce distributional bias and potential contamination from model-generated prompts. Use requires ethical review/handling and may have limited public availability.
